Daily Quiz.question: ১) Which is not from The Old English Period?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Beowulf, The Wanderer, The Seafarer are major literary works of The Old English Period. Campaspe is written by John Lyly in Elizabethan Age.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Who wrote ''Dr. Faustus''?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Christopher Marlowe (1564 – 93):
- A University Wit.
- Greatest Dramatist before Shakespeare.
- Father of English Tragedy.
Works: Tamburlaine the Great (1587), Dr. Faustus (1592), The Jew of Malta, Edward, The Passionate Shepherd to His Love (Poetry).
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Montague is the character of -
Daily Quiz.exp:
Characters of William Shakespeare's tragedy 'Romeo and Juliet' are Montague, Romeo, Juliet, Capulet.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) 'Tamburlaine the Great'' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Christopher Marlowe Works: Tamburlaine the Great (1587), Dr. Faustus (1592), The Jew of Malta, Edward, The Passionate Shepherd to His Love (Poetry).
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who supervised the compilation of the earliest English Prose “The Anglo-Saxon Chronicles”?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Alfred the Great encouraged and supervised the compilation of the earliest English Prose Anglo-Saxon Chronicle. Cynewulf is the writer of the christ. Caedmon is the first English poet.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Who translated the Bible into English?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Wycliffe (1324 – 1384) is Father of English prose. Translated Bible / New Testament into English prose. Cynewulf is the writer of the christ. Caedmon is the first English poet.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Canterbury Tales is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Canterbury Tales was written by Geoffrey Chaucher. Cynewulf is the writer of the christ. Caedmon is the first English poet.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Who is known as 'The Law Governing'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Alfred the Great encouraged and supervised the compilation of the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle. He is known as 'The Law Governing'. Sir Thomas Malory wrote his first romance in prose “Morte d’ Arthur”.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) 'Twelfth Night' is a comedy by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Notable comedy of William Shakespeare: Twelfth night, The Taming of the Shrew, Two gentlemen of Verona, The Merchant of Venice, As you like it, All's well that ends well, A Midsummer Night Dreams, The Tempest.
Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Who wrote the earliest epic Beowulf?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Beowulf, The Wanderer, The Seafarer are major literary works of The Old English Period. But their writers are anonymous.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Which is not Shakespeare's poem?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Shakespeare's Poem: A Lover’s Complaint. Venus and Adonis, The Rape of Lucrece, To The Queen, A Funeral Elegy, The Phoenix and The Turtle, The Passionate Pilgrim.
Shakespeare's Tragedy: Julius Caesar (1599), Antony and Cleopatra (1606), Coriolanus, Titus Andronicus, Romeo and Juliet (1594), Hamlet (1601), Troilus and Cressida, Othello (1604), Macbeth (1605), King lear (1605). Timon of Athens.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who wrote “The Shepherd's Calendar”?
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Shepheardes Calender, series of poems by Edmund Spenser, published in 1579 and considered to mark the beginning of the English Renaissance in literature.
Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who is the first English poet?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Caedmon is the first English poet. Venerable Bede is the father of English learning and he is the first historian.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Troilus and Cressida is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Troilus and Cressida is a play written by William Shakespear. Geoffrey Chaucer wrote ‘Troilus and Criseyde.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) “Revenge is a kind of wild justice” is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp: REVENGE is a kind of wild justice; which the more man's nature runs to, the more ought law to weed it out. Book - Of Revenge. Writer- Francis Bacon.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Who wrote ‘The Amoretti’?
Daily Quiz.exp:
In early 1595 he published Amoretti and Epithalamion, a sonnet sequence and a marriage ode celebrating his marriage to Elizabeth Boyle after what appears to have been an impassioned courtship in 1594. The Faerie Queen was Spenser’s unfinished epic. The type of sonnet being created by Spenser is called Spenserian sonnet.
Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Who wrote “Confessio Amantis”?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Gower wrote one of the major literature of The Middle English Period “Confessio Amantis”.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who is not from The Middle English Period?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Wycliffe, William Langland, John Gower, Geoffrey Chaucher, Sir Thomas Malory are the most famous writers of The Middle English Period.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Who is the heroine of Shakespeare’s play 'Hamlet'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Heroine is defined as a female character who possesses courage and other noble qualities; she is a character with whom readers are expected to sympathize. Ophelia certainly qualifies as one who has a great many noble qualities, and she is very sympathetic. Ophelia in William Shakespeare's drama ‘Hamlet’, is a young noblewoman of Denmark, the daughter of Polonius, sister of Laertes, and potential wife of Prince Hamlet.
Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Who wrote ‘Utopia’?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Utopia (or Kingdom of Nowhere) is a famous book of Thomas More. The book was originally written in Latin in 1516.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) Who is called the ‘poet of poets’?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Edmund Spenser is characterized by Charles Lamb as ' the Poets' Poet', while all the Elizabethans acclaimed him as 'the Prince of Poets.'
Source: academia.edu

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) Who wrote the first English Comedy?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Nicholas Udall wrote the first known English comedy, Ralph Roister Doister. In 1553.
Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) Who is called 'Father English of Tragedy'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Christopher Marlowe (1564 - 93) is called:
- A University Wit.
- Greatest Dramatist before Shakespeare.
- Father of English Tragedy.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) Who is not University Wit?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Thomas Kyd, John Lyly, Robert Greene, George Peele, Christopher Marlowe and Thomas Nashe are university wits.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) The Unfortunate Traveller was written by-

University Wit Thomas Nashe wrote “The Unfortunate Traveller”.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) 'As You Like It' is a play by-

Notable comedy of William Shakespeare: Twelfth night, The Taming of the Shrew, Two gentlemen of Verona, The Merchant of Venice, As you like it, All's well that ends well, A Midsummer Night Dreams, The Tempest.
Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) 'King Duncan' is a character in-
Daily Quiz.exp:
King Duncan, Macbeth, Macduff are the important characters of Shakespeare's play ‘Macbeth’. Macbeth was beheaded by Macduff.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) Which is Shakespeare's comedy?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Shakespeare's Comedy:
The Comedy of Errors (1599), Love’s Labour’s Lost, A Midsummer Night’s Dream, The Two Gentlemen of Verona, The Merchant of Venice, Much ado about nothing, Merry Wives of Windsor, As You Like It, Twelfth Night, All’s Well That Ends Well, Cymbeline, Measure for Measure, The Taming of the Shrew, The Two Noble Kinsmen, The Winter’s Tale, The Tempest, ‘Pericles, Prince of Tyre’.
Shakespeare's Tragedy:
Julius Caesar (1599), Antony and Cleopatra (1606), Coriolanus, Titus Andronicus, Romeo and Juliet (1594), Hamlet (1601), Troilus and Cressida, Othello (1604), Macbeth (1605), King lear (1605). Timon of Athens.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) The Spanish Tragedy is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp: The Spanish Tragedy (1585) is written by University Wit Thomas Kyd.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) Which one is the youngest daughter of the King Lear?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Characters of William Shakespeare's tragedy 'King Lear' are Goneril, Regan, Cordelia, Edgar.
Cordelia is the youngest daughter of the King Lear.
